instruction: Add a function `merge_intervals(intervals)` to intervals.py. Input is a list of (start, end) pairs with start <= end, in any order. Return a new list of (start, end) tuples sorted by start, in which overlapping intervals AND intervals that merely touch (e.g. (1, 3) and (3, 5)) are merged into one. An empty input returns []. The caller's list must not be mutated (do not sort it in place), and every output element must be a tuple even if the input contains lists. Raise ValueError if any interval has start > end. Do not change `overlaps()`. All tests in tests/test_intervals.py must pass.
